pregame.whyWatch: CJ Carr (ND QB, So): 1378 pass yds, 16 TD, 1 INT, 9.6 Y/A. Big plays with almost no turnovers. The test is whether he still pushes the ball when the first read is covered and the pocket gets muddy.
pregame.pressurePoint: Notre Dame deep passing vs BYU secondary. BYU is No. 25 of 138 at limiting explosive passes (1.38). Notre Dame ranks No. 99 in pass explosiveness (1.45).
